request.request-id-missing: The download has no request id, which keeps a retry from sending it twice. Reload the page and try again.
request.client-missing: Pick the download client to send it to.
request.destination-missing: Pick the destination to send it to.

jobs.status-unknown: “{{value}}” is not a download status. Use Created, Submitted, Downloading, Paused, Downloaded, Failed, NeedsLinking or Cancelled.
jobs.view-unknown: “{{value}}” is not a view of the jobs. Use NeedsYou, InProgress or Finished.

release-missing: This release isn't available any more: a search keeps what it found for a day. Search again.
destination-gone: The destination you picked no longer exists. Reload the page and pick one again.
client-gone: The download client you picked no longer exists. Reload the page and pick one again.

send.request-id-reused: This request id was already used to send a different download. Reload the page and try again.
send.source-removed: The source that listed this release has been removed, so the release can't be fetched. Search again.
send.destination-of-other-client: “{{destination}}” is a destination of another download client. Pick one of “{{client}}”’s.
send.already-sent: This release was already sent to “{{client}}”, so it isn't sent twice.
send.client-switched-off: “{{client}}” is switched off. The owner can switch it on under Integrations.

cannot-take.torrent-files: “{{client}}” can't take .torrent files, which this release is.
cannot-take.magnet-links: “{{client}}” can't take magnet links, which this release is.
cannot-take.nzb-files: “{{client}}” can't take NZB files, which this release is.
cannot-take.torrents: “{{client}}” can't take torrents, which this release is.

send.source-switched-off: “{{source}}” is switched off, so its releases can't be fetched. The owner can switch it on under Integrations.
send.source-type-unavailable: This version of the app can't fetch releases from “{{type}}”.

cancel.already-downloaded: This download is already finished, so there's nothing to stop following.
cancel.already-failed: This download has already failed, so there's nothing to stop following.
cancel.already-cancelled: This download is already cancelled, so there's nothing to stop following.
cancel.still-being-sent: This download is still being sent, so it can't be cancelled yet. Try again in a few minutes.

sender.locator-unreadable: The release's download link can't be read with this installation's encryption key, so nothing was sent. Search again.
sender.replacement-magnet: This release turned out to be a magnet link, whose files the app can't check before sending, so nothing was sent and no copy will be replaced. Pick Keep both to download it.

turned-out.torrent-file: “{{client}}” can't take a .torrent file, which this release turned out to be, so nothing was sent.
turned-out.magnet: “{{client}}” can't take a magnet link, which this release turned out to be, so nothing was sent.
turned-out.nzb: “{{client}}” can't take an NZB file, which this release turned out to be, so nothing was sent.

sender.v2-only: “{{client}}” can't take a torrent that is BitTorrent v2 only, which this release is, so nothing was sent.
sender.category-missing: “{{client}}” has no category “{{category}}” any more, so nothing was sent: it would have created one in its default folder. Create the category again in “{{client}}”, or the owner edits the destination.
sender.already-has-torrent: “{{client}}” already has this torrent, so nothing was sent.
sender.outside-libraries-destination: The folder of the destination “{{destination}}” isn't inside a library the app knows, so nothing was sent and no copy will be replaced. Pick Keep both to download it, or the owner fixes the destination.
sender.outside-libraries-category: The folder of the category “{{category}}” isn't inside a library the app knows, so nothing was sent and no copy will be replaced. Pick Keep both to download it, or the owner fixes the destination.
sender.overwrite-check-failed-destination: The app couldn't check whether this release would write over a file in the folder of the destination “{{destination}}”, so nothing was sent. The app's log says why.
sender.overwrite-check-failed-category: The app couldn't check whether this release would write over a file in the folder of the category “{{category}}”, so nothing was sent. The app's log says why.
sender.folder-unusable: “{{client}}” can't use the folder of the destination “{{destination}}” any more, so nothing was sent. The owner checks the destination under Destinations in the user menu.

overwrite.refused-destination: “{{client}}” would write over “{{path}}” in the folder of the destination “{{destination}}”: {{why, message}}, so nothing was sent.
overwrite.refused-category: “{{client}}” would write over “{{path}}” in the folder of the category “{{category}}”: {{why, message}}, so nothing was sent.
overwrite.refused-destination-more_one: “{{client}}” would write over “{{path}}” in the folder of the destination “{{destination}}”: {{why, message}}, so nothing was sent. One more of the release's files would land on a file already there too.
overwrite.refused-destination-more_other: “{{client}}” would write over “{{path}}” in the folder of the destination “{{destination}}”: {{why, message}}, so nothing was sent. {{count, number}} more of the release's files would land on files already there too.
overwrite.refused-category-more_one: “{{client}}” would write over “{{path}}” in the folder of the category “{{category}}”: {{why, message}}, so nothing was sent. One more of the release's files would land on a file already there too.
overwrite.refused-category-more_other: “{{client}}” would write over “{{path}}” in the folder of the category “{{category}}”: {{why, message}}, so nothing was sent. {{count, number}} more of the release's files would land on files already there too.
overwrite.different-size-clause: a file of another size is already there
overwrite.different-content-clause: a file of the same size but other content is already there
overwrite.not-a-file-clause: something that isn't a file is already there
overwrite.changed-clause: the file already there changed while the app compared it
overwrite.queued-torrent-clause: the torrent “{{torrent}}” it already has will write there
overwrite.already-there-clause: a file is already there, and a replacement never lands on a file already there
overwrite.unreadable-clause: a file the app couldn't read to compare is already there
overwrite.unchecked-destination: The app couldn't check every place this release would write in the folder of the destination “{{destination}}” ({{why, message}}), so nothing was sent and no copy will be replaced. Pick Keep both to download it.
overwrite.unchecked-category: The app couldn't check every place this release would write in the folder of the category “{{category}}” ({{why, message}}), so nothing was sent and no copy will be replaced. Pick Keep both to download it.

unchecked.file-list-clause: the .torrent's list of files can't be read
unchecked.folder-unknown-clause: the folder has no path in the app
unchecked.outside-media-folders-clause: the folder, or a link on the way to one of its places, lies outside the Media folders
unchecked.client-jobs-folder-clause: the client couldn't list its torrents in that folder, or their files
unchecked.client-jobs-category-clause: the client couldn't list its torrents in the category, or their files
unchecked.file-name-clause: a file's name holds characters the app can't look up

follow.client-removed: The download client “{{client}}” was removed, so this download can't be followed. Cancel the job to stop tracking it.
follow.switched-off: “{{client}}” is switched off, so this download isn't followed for now. The owner can switch it on under Integrations.
follow.type-unavailable: This version of the app can't follow downloads in “{{type}}”.
follow.client-error: “{{client}}” reports an error for this download, so it isn't moving on. Check it in “{{client}}”: the job goes on by itself once the error clears.
follow.missing: “{{client}}” doesn't list this download any more. It is still followed in case it comes back; to send the release again, cancel this job first.
follow.not-listed: “{{client}}” took this download but hasn't listed it since. It is still followed; to send the release again, cancel this job first.
follow.interrupted-before-hashes: The app stopped while sending this download, before it could tell whether “{{client}}” took it, so it isn't followed. Check “{{client}}” before sending the release again.
follow.interrupted-not-listed: The app stopped while sending this download, and “{{client}}” doesn't list it, so it isn't followed. Send the release again if you still want it.

member.source-failed: “{{source}}” couldn't hand over the release, so nothing was sent. Ask the owner to check “{{source}}” under Integrations.
member.client-failed: “{{client}}” couldn't take the release, so nothing was sent. Ask the owner to check “{{client}}” under Integrations.
member.client-not-asked: “{{client}}” couldn't be asked about this download. Ask the owner to check “{{client}}” under Integrations.

mcp.destination-not-offered: This destination isn't one of this release's download options; give one of the destinations get_download_options lists for it.

options.no-clients: No download client can take this release yet. The owner sets them up under Integrations and Destinations.
options.pick-destination_one: {{count, number}} download client can take this release; the Download dialog would preselect “{{destination}}” of “{{client}}”.
options.pick-destination_other: {{count, number}} download clients can take this release; the Download dialog would preselect “{{destination}}” of “{{client}}”.
options.pick-destination-tail_one: {{count, number}} download client can take this release; the Download dialog would preselect “{{destination}}” of “{{client}}”, and {{tail, message}}.
options.pick-destination-tail_other: {{count, number}} download clients can take this release; the Download dialog would preselect “{{destination}}” of “{{client}}”, and {{tail, message}}.
options.pick-client_one: {{count, number}} download client can take this release; the Download dialog would preselect “{{client}}” with no destination.
options.pick-client_other: {{count, number}} download clients can take this release; the Download dialog would preselect “{{client}}” with no destination.
options.pick-client-tail_one: {{count, number}} download client can take this release; the Download dialog would preselect “{{client}}” with no destination, and {{tail, message}}.
options.pick-client-tail_other: {{count, number}} download clients can take this release; the Download dialog would preselect “{{client}}” with no destination, and {{tail, message}}.
options.pick-none_one: {{count, number}} download client can take this release; the Download dialog would preselect no client.
options.pick-none_other: {{count, number}} download clients can take this release; the Download dialog would preselect no client.
options.pick-none-tail_one: {{count, number}} download client can take this release; the Download dialog would preselect no client, and {{tail, message}}.
options.pick-none-tail_other: {{count, number}} download clients can take this release; the Download dialog would preselect no client, and {{tail, message}}.
options.checked-there-clause: a release sent there is checked for files it would write over
options.checked-to-clause: a release sent to “{{destination}}” is checked for files it would write over
options.not-seen-there-clause: nothing can be sent there: its download client can't see the folder
options.not-seen-to-clause: nothing can be sent to “{{destination}}”: its download client can't see the folder
options.unchecked-there-clause: a release sent there goes without the check for files it would write over ({{reason}})
options.unchecked-to-clause: a release sent to “{{destination}}” goes without the check for files it would write over ({{reason}})

send.sent: Sent “{{release}}” to “{{client}}” and the job is {{status}}; list_jobs and get_job follow it.
send.sent-into: Sent “{{release}}” to “{{client}}”, into “{{destination}}”, and the job is {{status}}; list_jobs and get_job follow it.
send.failed: Sending “{{release}}” to “{{client}}” failed: {{why, message}} A new send needs a new requestId.
send.failed-into: Sending “{{release}}” to “{{client}}”, into “{{destination}}”, failed: {{why, message}} A new send needs a new requestId.
send.replayed: This requestId already sent “{{release}}” to “{{client}}” so nothing was sent again; the job is {{status}}.
send.replayed-into: This requestId already sent “{{release}}” to “{{client}}”, into “{{destination}}”, so nothing was sent again; the job is {{status}}.
send.replayed-failed: This requestId already tried to send “{{release}}” to “{{client}}” and that send failed: {{why, message}} A new send needs a new requestId.
send.replayed-failed-into: This requestId already tried to send “{{release}}” to “{{client}}”, into “{{destination}}”, and that send failed: {{why, message}} A new send needs a new requestId.

jobs.listed_one: {{count, number}} job matches; this page lists {{shown, number}}. Among all your jobs, NeedsYou holds {{needsYou, number}} and InProgress {{inProgress, number}}.
jobs.listed_other: {{count, number}} jobs match; this page lists {{shown, number}}. Among all your jobs, NeedsYou holds {{needsYou, number}} and InProgress {{inProgress, number}}.
jobs.cancelled: MAM no longer follows “{{release}}”: the job is Cancelled, and the torrent stays in “{{client}}” as it is.

job.summary-progress-why: “{{release}}” in “{{client}}” is {{status}} at {{percent, number}}%; {{listed, message}}. {{why, list:space:message}}

listed.none-clause: its download client hasn't listed its files yet
listed.first-clause_one: the first {{shown, number}} of its {{count, number}} file is listed
listed.first-clause_other: the first {{shown, number}} of its {{count, number}} files are listed
